data.body:
The published 0.1.0 artifact passed source/archive/consumer verification, but its unprotected main branch and mutable GitHub release did not satisfy the extraction release protocol. This PR records the 0.1.1 successor and closes those release-automation gaps.

The workflow now refuses an unprotected release ref before tag/release mutation, preserves the existing tag ancestry and release-record checks, refuses mutable/draft/prerelease existing releases, and checks exact immutable published state after publication. The predicates reject missing, malformed and multi-object API responses; 31 isolated fixtures exercise them without making online-state claims.

All three version-bound manifests and their handoff digests now identify 0.1.1. The handoff cites this PR and preserves its migration/change-set/NRM identifiers, original source baseline, exact consumer inventory and package/App test ownership. Production source and public signatures are unchanged.

Validation: complete package CI passes at `dcfeb9cc451587d921f96483ddca491fbf197b4f`: [workflow](https://github.com/kumwe/access-context/actions/runs/34115532630). 63 package tests / 914 assertions; 12 release-record parser cases; 31 release-integrity fixtures; maximum strict analysis/style/manifests; security audit; actual built ZIP installed as a no-dev dependency with 11 public symbols and all three shipped examples. The App strict Version 2 manifest loader also accepts the successor handoff.

Before merging, the maintainer must protect main and enable GitHub immutable releases. The setting affects future publications: keep 0.1.0 and its tag intact. No administrative endpoint, admin PAT, repository settings change, manual tag, merge or publication is included. The ordinary workflow token verifies the public release metadata. If protections were not configured, the workflow fails closed; it does not repair an already-published version.

A fresh independent successor release attestation remains required before dependent package work or App adoption. See `docs/releasing.md` for the setup and verification order.

data.body:
The extracted package's main branch could not pass its own manifest checks or complete its declared quality lane. It also lacked the v2 handoff, member/API guide, archive consumer proof and release workflows needed for independent adoption.

This PR completes that package boundary:

- Fix explicit-null checks, existing strict-analysis/style defects, and control bytes silently discarded before scope validation.
- Reject step-up workspace scope without an organization; document the host's additional authorization and proof checks.
- Supply the charter, full public-member documentation, architecture/security/integration/releasing guides, and MIG004/CS004 handoff linked to this PR with the precise App baseline, 578 consumers and 227 retained integration test paths.
- Add the full PHP 8.5 CI lane, release-record parser and merged-record release workflow, plus an exact 30-file ZIP installed as the sole dependency in an isolated no-dev authoritative consumer.

Validation on PHP 8.5.10 and Composer 2.10.3: 63 tests / 914 assertions, 12 release-parser cases, PHPStan max with strict/deprecation rules, style, syntax, docs, boundaries, public manifests, three examples and isolated archive consumption passed. The current App v2 PackageManifests loader also passed.

[GitHub Context CI run 34111823414](https://github.com/kumwe/access-context/actions/runs/34111823414) passed on commit `95fa9ddbd8124987162e8a8ee3b03c4eb79c8123`, including the mandatory online dependency audit and additional production-autoloader validation. The local audit network timeout is documented in the handoff; CI supplies the successful online evidence.

This is Phase 1 package completion for NRM-2026-005. App adoption requires a human merge, immutable package publication and a fresh independent verification; no App integration or published-release claim is made.

data.body:
Phase 1 extraction, `KUMWE-MIG-2026-004` / `KUMWE-CS-2026-004`. **Work in progress, handed over mid-extraction.** This is the tree exactly as the session left it; nothing was added to make it look finished.

`kumwe/app` is untouched, as Phase 1 requires.

## What is here

- Values under the curated `Kumwe\Context` namespace: `ExecutionContext`, `MembershipContext`, `SiteContext`, `OrganizationContext`, `WorkspaceContext`, `AuthenticatedSurface`, `AuthenticationStrength`, `StepUpProof`.
- Contracts `Principal` and `SystemActor`, and the `InvalidContext` refusal.
- Invariant and hostile-input tests with their support doubles.
- Three runnable examples, the public API, capabilities and service-map manifests recording that context is supplied explicitly and never resolved from a container, and the dependency-free check-lane tools.

## What is missing

- `CHARTER.md`, and the architecture, integration, public API, releasing and security documents.
- The continuous-integration and release-on-record workflows.
- The complete `composer check` lane has never been run to green against this tree.
- No `MIGRATION-HANDOFF.md`. Under the Version 2 handoff schema it is written after the draft pull request exists, with this pull request's URL, and Phase 2 cannot start without it.

## Before this can be marked ready

Finish the items above, run the complete lane to green, commit the handoff with this pull request's URL, rerun the lane on the final head, and mark ready only when every check on the head commit is green. The namespace is curated and deliberate: it is `Kumwe\Context`, never derived from the repository slug.
